newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian SIDANKO again fails to regain Purneftegaz.
newsitem.headline: Russian SIDANKO again fails to regain Purneftegaz.

text.p: Russia's NK SIDANKO oil company has lost a second court attempt to regain the Purneftegaz crude production unit from state oil company Rosneft, a Rosneft spokesman said on Wednesday.
Vladimir Turmarkin said a Moscow arbitration court had ruled on Monday against SIDANKO's claim that the State Property Committee had illegally stripped SIDANKO of Purneftegaz.
Officials had declined until Wednesday to comment on the results of Monday's hearing.
SIDANKO (Sibirsko-Dalnevostochnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya, or the Siberian-Far Eastern Oil Company) lost a similar case last month, lodged against the government, in the Supreme Arbitration Court.
The latest decision is a victory for Rosneft, which is to be privatised but which had lost many of its best assets under industry restructuring.
A 1994 government resolution awarded Purneftegaz to SIDANKO, but a 1995 ruling shifted ownership of the producer to Rosneft.
The changes were part of the government's remodelling of the once state-run oil sector into vertically integrated companies.
Neither the State Property Committee nor SIDANKO were available for comment.
